name: Benzylone
summary: Benzylone is a recreational designer drug from the substituted cathinone family, with stimulant effects. It has been commonly encountered in seizures of street drug samples but appears to have relatively low potency on its own, being mainly found as a component of mixtures with other related drugs.

pharmacology.text: Benzylone (also known as 3,4-methylenedioxy-N-benzylcathinone or BMDP) is a recreational designer drug from the substituted cathinone family, with stimulant effects.

uses.text: Benzylone (also known as 3,4-methylenedioxy-N-benzylcathinone or BMDP) is a recreational designer drug from the substituted cathinone family, with stimulant effects. It has been commonly encountered in seizures of street drug samples but appears to have relatively low potency on its own, being mainly found as a component of mixtures with other related drugs.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cathinones, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, sleeplessness, anxiety, paranoia and psychosis, and carry a high risk of compulsive redosing.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同類的合成卡西酮可能造成心跳急促、血壓升高、失眠、焦慮、妄想與精神病，並有高度的強迫性連續補用風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同类的合成卡西酮可能造成心跳急促、血压升高、失眠、焦虑、妄想与精神病，并有高度的强迫性连续补用风险。

fact.en: It is methylone with a benzyl group on the nitrogen instead of a methyl. Chemists noticed that this big group weakens its effect, yet it still turns up often in seized street samples.
fact.zh: 它是把 methylone 氮原子上的甲基換成苄基的產物。化學家注意到這個龐大的基團會減弱其作用，但它仍經常出現在查獲的街頭樣本中。
fact.zhHans: 它是把 methylone 氮原子上的甲基换成苄基的产物。化学家注意到这个庞大的基团会减弱其作用，但它仍经常出现在查获的街头样本中。
